text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, and making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data without being explicitly programmed. They improve at tasks by recognizing patterns in large amounts of information. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning, using layered neural networks to process complex data. You encounter AI every day, often without noticing. Speech assistants like Siri use it to understand your voice, streaming services recommend movies based on your history, and email filters identify spam. AI also powers navigation apps, self-checkout machines, and even medical diagnosis tools, making many everyday tasks faster and more convenient.
